title: Rebling Aero Battery Receptacles – Hollow Posts
description: 7002 Style 1 Aero Battery Receptacle is a two-pin type receptacle conform to MS3509 style 1 and are on the Qualified Products List (QPL) per MIL-E-81099 Attached directly to the battery housing Available with hollow or threaded post electrical connections (available with Terminal Adapters) Color coded, pink for lead acid and blue for nickel cadmium type batteries Designed to mate with Rebling’s Series 7000 Quick Disconnects and those conforming to MS25182-2 and MS3349-2 Hollow or Threaded posts Shaped to insure correct polarity is maintained when connecting the battery to the system Variety of Terminal Adapter configurations
